test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

__Extreme sadness and pitiful cries__ of people filled the whole atmosphere.
solution:
The correct answer is: **The heart-rending cries**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words for 'cries'.
 
 
• **Loud**: Making a lot of noise; not quiet. (उच्च स्वर)
 
• **Continuous**: Withou
